record.reason: This study compares activation memory (KV cache) with parametric memory in few-shot learning and tests when information stored in either form is effective. It is directly related to memory representation but does not propose a runtime memory/KV-cache reduction or serving optimization; evidence is explanatory and the practical inference-efficiency connection remains weak.
record.title: Complementary Roles of Activation and Parametric Memory in Few-Shot Learning
